questions.subject: english
questions.question: is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh line T.S. Eliot ki kavita 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' se li gayi hai jisme Macavity ki shararaton ka varnan hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: — whose brow is the poet talking about?
questions.explanation: Kavi Macavity ke mathe (brow) ki baat kar rahe hain jo gahri soch aur yojanaon ke kaaran rekhaon se bhara rehta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' has been taken from ..........

options.B: Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats

questions.explanation: Yeh kavita T. S. Eliot ke prasiddh kavya-sangrah 'Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who finds Macavity lazy and half asleep?
questions.explanation: Kavi T.S. Eliot kavita mein Macavity ko aalas karte aur aadha soya hua paate hain, jabki weh hamesha chaukanna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'He's broken every human law, he breaks the law of gravity' is taken from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh line 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' kavita se li gayi hai, jisme uski hawa mein udne aur kanoon todne ki kshamta batayi gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' is written by ..........
questions.explanation: Is kavita ke rachyita prasiddh adhunik kavi T. S. Eliot hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity is a ..........
questions.explanation: Macavity ek chatur aur rahasyamayi billi (cat) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity is called ..........
questions.explanation: Macavity ko apradh sthal par nishan na chhodne ke kaaran 'the Hidden Paw' kaha jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet compares Macavity to ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi ne Macavity ko apradhiyon ka neta maante hue uski tulna Napoleon ('Napoleon of Crime') se ki hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... is from his collection called 'Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats'.
questions.explanation: 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' T.S. Eliot ke sangrah 'Old Possum's Book of Practical Cats' ka hissa hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... is a master criminal who can defy the Law.
questions.explanation: Kavita ke mutabiq Macavity ek master criminal hai jo kisi bhi kanoon ki parwah nahi karta.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity is .......... on the scene of crime.
questions.explanation: Jab bhi police apradh ke sthan par pahunchti hai, Macavity wahan kabhi nahi milta ('Macavity's not there').

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who wrote 'The Waste Land' and 'Four Quartets'?
questions.explanation: 'The Waste Land' aur 'Four Quartets' T.S. Eliot ki vishva-prasiddh rachnayein hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'You'll be sure to find him resting' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh line kavita 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Perhaps Macavity is portrayed as the fictional cat of ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita mein Macavity kavi T. S. Eliot ki kalpana aur unke sangrah ki pramukh billi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: T. S. Eliot is a .......... poet.
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot 20vin sadi (Twentieth Century) ke sabse mahan aur prabhavshali kaviyon mein se ek the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'He always has an alibi, and one or two to spare' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh prasiddh pankti 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' kavita se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: — whom is the poet referring to?
questions.explanation: Kavi Macavity ke baare mein kehte hain ki weh upar se dekhne mein bahut sharif aur sammanit lagta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When the police reach the scene of crime, they don't find .......... there.
questions.explanation: Ghatna sthal par police ko kabhi bhi Macavity maujood nahi milta.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity is full of ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita ke anusaar Macavity dhokhebazi aur fareb (deceitfulness) se bhari hui billi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'The Waste Land' has been composed by ..........
questions.explanation: 'The Waste Land' ki rachna T.S. Eliot ne ki thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity moves his head from side to side like a ..........
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'He sways his head from side to side, with movement like a snake'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: T. S. Eliot is one of the pioneers of .......... poetry.
questions.explanation: T.S. Eliot ko modern poetry (adhunik kavita) ke mukhya agradooton mein gina jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: This poem is written in a .......... vein.
questions.explanation: Yeh kavita hasya aur vyangya se yukt Mock-heroic shaili mein likhi gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity's eyes are ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita ke anusar uski aankhein andar ki or dhansi hui (sunken in) hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: People say that Macavity cheats at ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita mein likha hai: 'They say he cheats at cards'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of 'Larder' in the poem?

options.B: A cupboard or store for food (meat safe)

questions.explanation: 'Larder' ka matlab bhojan ya khane-peene ki cheezein surakshit rakhne ki almari hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Scotland Yard and its .......... fail to catch Macavity.
questions.explanation: Macavity Scotland Yard aur uske Flying Squad ke liye nirasha ka kaaran bana hua hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity has the magical power of ..........
questions.explanation: Macavity ke paas hawa mein tairne/uthne ki shakti (power of levitation) hai jise dekh kar fakir bhi dang rah jayein.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Macavity has broken not only human laws but also the law of ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita kehti hai ki weh gurutwakarshan ke niyam (law of gravity) ko bhi tod deta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which prestigious award did T. S. Eliot receive in 1948?
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ko saal 1948 mein Nobel Prize mila tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: T. S. Eliot got the Nobel Prize Award for ..........
questions.explanation: Unhin saahitya (Literature) ke kshetr mein Nobel Prize diya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Macavity: The Mystery Cat' is a .......... poem.
questions.explanation: Yeh ek halki-phulki (light) aur manranjak kavita hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: T. S. Eliot was born in USA but eventually settled in ..........
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ka janam America mein hua tha lekin baad mein weh England mein sthayi roop se bas gaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: T. S. Eliot was a distinguished critic and a ..........
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ek mahan aalochak (critic) ke sath-sath natakkar (dramatist) bhi the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When did T. S. Eliot receive the Nobel Prize?
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ko saal 1948 mein Nobel Prize se sammanit kiya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Eliot's cat poem was adapted into a musical on stage by the great composer ..........
questions.explanation: Mahan sangeetkar Sir Andrew Lloyd Webber ne ise manch par sangeet natak ke roop mein prastut kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: T. S. Eliot described himself in religion as an ..........
questions.explanation: Eliot ne dharmik roop se khud ko Anglo-Catholic bataya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Give the synonym of 'Disclose'.
questions.explanation: 'Disclose' ka arth samne lana ya kholna hota hai, jiska sahi samanarthi 'Reveal' hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Give the synonym of 'Alibi' in context of criminal investigation.
questions.explanation: 'Alibi' ka matlab apradh ke samay doosri jagah maujood hone ka pakka bahana ya saboot hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which city and state of the USA was T. S. Eliot born?
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ka janam America ke St. Louis, Missouri shahar mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was T. S. Eliot born?
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ka janam saal 1888 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did T. S. Eliot pass away?
questions.explanation: T. S. Eliot ka nidhan saal 1965 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In politics, T. S. Eliot described himself as a ..........
questions.explanation: Eliot ne rajneeti mein khud ko rajshahi samarthak yani 'royalist' ghoshit kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In literature, T. S. Eliot considered himself a ..........
questions.explanation: Saahitya ke kshetr mein weh shastriyata ke pakshdhar yani 'classicist' the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What kind of cat is Macavity physically described as in the poem?

options.B: A ginger cat, tall and thin

questions.explanation: Kavita ke anusaar Macavity ek lambi aur dubli adrak-rang (ginger) ki billi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why is Macavity's coat described as dusty?
questions.explanation: Kavita ki line hai: 'His coat is dusty from neglect', kyunki weh apni safayi par dhyan nahi deta.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How are Macavity's whiskers described in the text?
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'his whiskers are uncombed' yaani uski moonchein bikhri hui hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How is Macavity's head shaped?
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'his head is highly domed' yaani uska sir gumbad ki tarah ubhra hua hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When you think Macavity is half asleep, what is he in reality?
questions.explanation: Jab lagta hai ki weh so raha hai, asal mein weh poori tarah chaukanna (wide awake) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What kind of pet dog is mentioned as being stifled in the poem?
questions.explanation: Kavita mein likha hai: 'or another Peke's been stifled', jo ek chhote kutte ki nasal hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What missing item causes distress in the Foreign Office?
questions.explanation: Videsh mantralaya (Foreign Office) ki ek mahatvapurna sandhi (Treaty) gayab ho jati hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the Admiralty lose by the way?
questions.explanation: Nausena vibhag (Admiralty) ke zaroori plans aur drawings raste mein kho jate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When a crime or loss is disclosed, what does the Secret Service say?
questions.explanation: Guptchar vibhag hamesha yahi kehta hai: 'It must have been Macavity!'

questions.subject: english
questions.question: When suspected of a crime, what is Macavity usually found doing a mile away?

options.B: Resting, licking his thumbs, or doing division sums

questions.explanation: Weh aaram se baithkar anguthe chaatta ya ganit ke kathin sawal hal karta dikhta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which other two wicked cats are explicitly mentioned in the poem?
questions.explanation: Kavi do anya apradhi billiyon ke naam Mungojerrie aur Griddlebone batate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the relationship between Mungojerrie, Griddlebone, and Macavity?

options.C: They are merely agents controlled by Macavity

questions.explanation: Weh dono keval Macavity ke agent hain aur Macavity unki sabhi gatividhiyon ko niyantrit karta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why is Macavity called the 'Napoleon of Crime'?

options.A: Because he was born in France
options.B: Because he is the mastermind controlling all feline criminal operations
options.C: Because he wears a military uniform

questions.explanation: Weh apradhi billiyon ka mukhiya aur master strategist hai, isliye use Napoleon of Crime kaha gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the phrase 'a monster of depravity', what does 'depravity' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Depravity' ka arth bhrashtata, durachar ya burayi hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the word 'fiend' mean in the phrase 'fiend in feline shape'?
questions.explanation: 'Fiend' ka matlab rakshas ya shaitan (evil demon) hota hai jo billi ke roop mein maujood hai.
